title: Cancellation Notice and Fee Figures for Each Northbeam Fulfilment Service
content:
For every fulfilment service of Northbeam Purchase Orders and Fulfilment two figures govern a cancellation. The
notice figure is the hours of notice needed to cancel without a charge. The fee figure is the charge for cancelling
inside that notice period.

| Fulfilment service | Notice needed to cancel without a charge, hours | Cancellation fee |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Standard Parcel Delivery | 12 | 0.00 |
| Store Pickup Hold | 0 | 0.00 |
| Threshold Delivery | 24 | 0.00 |
| Room of Choice Delivery with Haul Away | 48 | 45.00 |
| White Glove Delivery and Installation | 48 | 95.00 |
| Business Dock and Freight Delivery | 72 | 250.00 |

## What the two columns say service by service

Three of the six services carry a nil cancellation fee: Standard Parcel Delivery, Store Pickup Hold and Threshold
Delivery. On those three the fee figure that would attach to a cancellation inside the notice period is 0.00. The fee
figure rises with the size of the crew and the carriage: 45.00 on Room of Choice Delivery with Haul Away, 95.00 on
White Glove Delivery and Installation, and 250.00 on Business Dock and Freight Delivery.

Store Pickup Hold carries a notice figure of 0 hours, so there are no hours of notice for it to ask for; the two
two-person home services ask for 48 hours, and the freight service for 72 hours.
